headline: Approved previous meeting minutes; discussed monument repairs, tree trimming estimates, and a grave invoice.
summary: The meeting reviewed the financial report, which showed $187,560.07 in investments as of July 31, 2026. Members discussed monument repairs, estimates to remove and trim trees, and an invoice for a grave. The previous meeting's minutes were approved.
